hero_desc_zh: 火红长发，黑铁鎏金符文战甲，火焰光晕环绕周身，面颊符文发光，以烈焰为武器（火焰冲击波、熔岩爆炸、烈焰横扫）

opponent.desc_zh: 全身黑曜石质感、轮廓不断剥离缕缕黑烟，细长的紫色发光眼缝，胸口紫色V形符印发光
opponent.desc_en: matte obsidian-black humanoid, narrow glowing violet-purple eye-slits, glowing violet chevron sigil on the chest, wisps of dark smoke peeling off its outline

environment.desc_en: wind-eroded ember wasteland, drifting ash and glowing embers in the dust
environment.desc_zh: 荒芜的余烬战场，风蚀荒漠，余烬与扬尘飞舞
